description: xAI Grok login: a non-streamed client: xAI's reply is read as one response (the extension reads an event stream or a JSON reply alike).

exceptions.reason: Today's core's Codex translator sends empty instructions on every Responses request; the extension sends the request's instructions as the client wrote them.

The new core sends the reasoning effort the client asked for (reasoning_effort, a Messages thinking budget's effort or a model-name suffix) whatever the model, and gives a translated request that names none the medium effort today's core gives it; today's core checks the effort against its model catalog and drops it for a model it does not list, such as gpt-test. The *-catalog-model cases and the codex-oauth cases show both cores sending it for a model today's core lists.
Today's core derives a session ID per conversation and sends it as prompt_cache_key; the extension has no session identity to derive from, so it sends only the client's own prompt_cache_key.
Today's core sends its session ID as the x-grok-conv-id header; the extension sends the header only when the client's body carries a prompt_cache_key, since it has no session identity of its own.
A non-streamed client gets a non-streamed upstream request, and its reply is read as one response; today's core always asks xAI for a stream and reads the stream into one reply.
Follows the request's stream flag (see the upstream stream exception); today's core always asks for an event stream.

A Grok login's requests carry the Grok CLI's User-Agent (xai-grok-workspace and the CLI version), which today's core forces on requests to the CLI's endpoint; on another address, such as the fake upstream, today's core forwards the client's User-Agent.

Today's core fills in zero cached and reasoning token counts when the upstream reports usage without them (EnsureResponsesUsageDetails); the new core reports xAI's usage as it comes. Whether to keep it is open.

The new core leaves out Chat message fields that have no value (tool_calls, reasoning_content) and the non-standard native_finish_reason; today's Codex translator writes them, null when empty.
